cases.counterparty: You are the host at Cedar Table Bistro. Reply in this exact order, one reply per assistant turn: Hello, this is Cedar Table.; Can I get the name of the reservation?; It is already canceled.; Okay.; No, I do not have any other reservation. Then stop. Do not add facts or requests.
cases.objective: Cancel Maya Chen’s dinner reservation and confirm that no other entry remains.
checks: Automation and recording disclosure before task details
At most two purpose sentences after disclosures
At most 35 words per turn except verbatim supplied messages
Phone at most once unless requested again
No full date with year unless requested
No tracked fact repeated unless explicitly asked
After a bare acknowledgement ask a question of at most 10 words
Success triggers end_call with one sentence
Do not invent a confirmation or exceed cancellation authority
